description: First successful full capture: 47 real Avalonia ControlCatalog frames. Reviewed defects include switch knob positioning, invisible white slider thumb in light mode, unharmonized page backgrounds, selection geometry and remaining inherited form treatments. This is a progress checkpoint, not a release baseline.
validation: Theme and ControlCatalog compile; capture succeeds. At this exact source commit, the test build still reports duplicate using directives/analyzer errors and package readme inclusion is not yet fixed. Later commits address these separately. No native macOS validation is claimed.
